title: TorusGuardEvidence
description: Evidence item schema for TorusGuard v0.5.0 findings.

type.description: Origin and modality of the evidence.

location.description: File path, line number range, configuration key, or route endpoint (e.g. app/views.py:45-52).

snippet.description: Sanitized excerpt of the offending source code, configuration, or log.

context.description: Surrounding architectural context (e.g. within unauthenticated FastAPI route handler).

rationale.description: Why this specific code snippet or configuration proves the presence of the weakness.

confidence_level.description: Confidence assessment derived solely from this evidence artifact.

is_sufficient_for_confirmed.description: True only if direct unmitigated vulnerability is proven without external assumptions.
